test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question has two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

No motor is a yak.

Some yaks are wipes.

Conclusions:

(I) No wipe is a yak.

(II) Some wipes are yaks.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1306a7ad075657c79c03eaac2be422f97a0e0787fa3c0ef3c78efe4d88dc5974.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) No wipe is a yak → False (As, Some yaks are wipes. so this conclusion is false).

(II) Some wipes are yaks → **True **(As, Some yaks are wipes, so Some wipes are yaks is true)

Thus, Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
